name: youtube
title: YouTube uploads (your channel, credentials stay in the server)
description: Publishes a video an agent made to your YouTube channel through the YouTube Data API v3, without the agent ever seeing your Google credentials: the OAuth client and its refresh token live only in this server's container, which refreshes its access token itself. upload_video (a video file of /upload, resumable upload with retries, private by default, unlisted on request, public only with YOUTUBE_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1; the audience required, the synthetic-content disclosure false unless set; chapters into the description), set_thumbnail (JPEG/PNG up to 2 MB), upload_captions (SRT/WebVTT), update_metadata (only the fields given) - these four WRITE to the channel: have sandbox-ai ask for each call - and list_my_videos (read-only). Every field is checked against YouTube's limits; files only from a folder mounted read-only at /upload, no links, devices or other users' files. Needs a Google Cloud project with the YouTube Data API v3, a Desktop OAuth client (YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID, YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET) and YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN (made once on the host with the server's authorize.py), and network: Allowlist with oauth2.googleapis.com:443 and www.googleapis.com:443. Uploads of a project Google has not audited stay private; an upload costs about 1600 of the project's 10,000 daily quota units.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client id of the Desktop app OAuth client of your Google Cloud project (...apps.googleusercontent.com)

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret of that OAuth client

env.name: YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Refresh token for your channel: python3 -I servers/youtube/src/authorize.py --client-secrets FILE | sandbox-ai secrets set YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN

env.name: YOUTUBE_ALLOW_PUBLIC
env.description: 1 lets upload_video and update_metadata make a video public and the write tools change a video that is public or scheduled to become public (unset: private and unlisted only)

env.name: YOUTUBE_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
env.description: Largest video upload_video takes, in MiB (1-262144, default 4096)

mounts.description: The videos, thumbnails and caption files to publish, read-only (--mount /upload=DIR:ro); without it nothing can be uploaded

notes: The refresh token gives the server what its scopes allow on your channel (authorize.py asks for youtube.upload and youtube.readonly by default; youtube.force-ssl only for captions and metadata updates): it stays in the server's container (environment, memory), is never returned and never logged, and the agent never sees it. Ask for every write: a ruleset with {"server": "youtube", "tool": ["upload_video", "set_thumbnail", "upload_captions", "update_metadata"], "decision": "ask"} makes sandbox-ai ask you for each call. Publish the OAuth consent screen (In production): in Testing, Google lets a refresh token expire after 7 days. Videos uploaded by an API project Google has not audited are locked to private until it passes the audit. sandbox-ai gives an allowlist entry the full network (it cannot limit a server to hosts yet); the server itself sends requests to these two hosts only.
